evals.prompt: Here's the Discussion draft for our sepsis early-warning paper (manuscript/discussion.md). Please do an anti-slop pass. Sample paragraph: 'It is important to note that our model demonstrated robust performance. Studies show that early warning scores reduce mortality. This is not just a technical problem, it's a clinical one. Moving forward, the landscape of sepsis care will continue to evolve.'
evals.expected_output: A prioritized P0/P1/P2 audit of the draft with direct rewrites, fixing the uncited 'studies show' and ungrounded 'robust' as P0 first.
expectations: Tags 'Studies show that...' without a citation as P0 (uncited attribution)
Tags 'robust performance' with no statistic attached as P0 (ungrounded intensifier)
Tags 'It is important to note that' and the 'not just X, it's Y' construction as P1
Tags 'Moving forward' and 'landscape' as P2 filler/business jargon
Orders fixes P0 first and provides direct rewrites where meaning is unambiguous

evals.prompt: Run the AI-tell check on my Methods section and get rid of all the passive voice and em-dashes, they read as ChatGPT. Example: 'Patients were excluded if they were transferred from another ICU. Sepsis was defined using Sepsis-3 criteria — suspected infection plus an acute SOFA increase of 2 or more points.'
evals.expected_output: The audit preserves procedural passive voice in Methods and the definitional em-dash, explaining the calibration rather than removing them.
expectations: Does not rewrite 'Patients were excluded...' into active voice since procedural passive is correct in Methods
Preserves the definitional em-dash defining Sepsis-3 (or only flags it for density if overused)
Explains the calibration against generic anti-slop rules
Does not change the technical meaning of the sepsis definition

evals.prompt: Results section check: we call the outcome '30-day all-cause mortality' in Methods, then 'death at one month', 'short-term mortality', and 'early death' in Results. Also there's 'a significant reduction in mortality' in the abstract with no p-value or CI nearby. Is this slop?
evals.expected_output: Flags the synonym rotation of a defined outcome and the ungrounded 'significant' as P0 correctness issues and recommends repeating the defined term verbatim and attaching the statistic.
expectations: Flags swapping '30-day all-cause mortality' for looser synonyms as a P0 technical-term issue
Recommends repeating the defined technical term verbatim
Flags 'significant reduction' without an adjacent statistic as P0
Does not invent a p-value, CI, or estimate to ground the claim
